newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANKS BID TO PLACE PLN 435 MLN WITH NBP.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANKS BID TO PLACE PLN 435 MLN WITH NBP.

text.p: WARSAW, Aug 14 (reuter) - Polish banks bid to place 435 million zlotys, in nominal terms, at the National Bank of Poland's reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction against a one billion zloty offer, the NBP said.
They also bid for 768 million zlotys of 91-day NBP-bills against a one billion offer.
Results of the auction should be available at about 1300 local time.
